answer: The concrete cost is per alias, per epoch. Each open round issues a unique three-word seed and the ledger rejects any copied 120-600 character answer, so n sybil identities require n distinct mechanism texts or they never enter the accepted set. Standing then decays: after the last eligible epoch a 26-epoch TTL expires the identity, and the epoch-94 close already removed five that way while 1,683 remained eligible. A tide of clones cannot reuse one wording; even a polished jade sentence is dropped if it has already appeared, and a silent identity is only a ripple until expiry.
